reportincident-dialog-harassment-type-la: Nooca dhaqanka aan la aqbali karin
reportincident-dialog-additional-details: Ku dar macluumaad dheeraad ah oo caawin kara dib u eegaha (tusaale ahaan, xiriiriyeyaal dheeraad ah).
reportincident-dialog-violator-disclaime: Hay'adda Wikimedia Foundation si ikhtiyaari ah uma sii dayn doonto {{GENDER:|aqoonsigaaga}} qofka {{GENDER:|aad}} ka warbixinayso
reportincident-dialog-harassment-type-do: Soo bandhigista macluumaadka gaarka ah ee shakhsiga (Doxing)
reportincident-dialog-something-else-inp: Sheeg dhaqamada aan kor lagu xusin.
reportincident-dialog-harassment-empty: {{GENDER:|Waa inaad}} doorataa ugu yaraan hal dhaqan.
reportincident-dialog-something-else-emp: Fadlan bixi sharaxaad kooban oo ku saabsan dhaqanka.
reportincident-dialog-internet-disconnec: Waxay u muuqataa in {{GENDER:|aadan}} lahayn xiriir internet. Fadlan isku day inaad dib u gudbiso marka {{GENDER:|xiriirkaaga}} soo noqdo.
reportincident-dialog-server-error: Waan ka xunnahay, waxay u muuqataa in adeegu aanu ka jawaabayn. Fadlan isku day inaad dib u gudbiso.
reportincident-dialog-generic-error: {{GENDER:|Codsigaaga}} lama gudbin karin sababo la xiriira khalad. Fadlan isku day inaad dib u gudbiso.
reportincident-unable-to-send: Lama abuuri karin warbixinta dhacdada. Haddii dhibaatadu sii socoto, fadlan iimayl u dir emergency@wikimedia.org adigoo ku lifaaqaya {{GENDER:|warbixintaada}} dhacdada.
reportincident-emaildialog-title: Iimayl la xaqiijiyay ayaa loo baahan yahay
reportincident-emaildialog-content: Waxaan u baahan nahay {{GENDER:|iimaylkaaga}} la xaqiijiyay si aan kuu siino warbixinno ku saabsan {{GENDER:|warbixinta}} ama aan kula soo xiriirno haddii loo baahdo. Fadlan ku dar ama xaqiiji {{GENDER:|iimaylkaaga}} adigoo ka adeegsanaya dejinta akoonkaaga ka hor intaadan gudbin warbixin.
reportincident-confirmedemail-required: Cinwaan iimayl la xaqiijiyay ayaa loo baahan yahay si loo gudbiyo warbixinta dhacdada.
reportincident-dialog-report-immediate-h: U gudbi hanjabaad degdeg ah oo waxyeello keeni karta kooxda xaaladaha degdegga ah
reportincident-physical-harm-infotext: Xiriiriyaha dhacdada {{GENDER:|aad}} ka warbixinayso (oo ay ku jirto isticmaalaha la soo sheegay) iyo magacaaga isticmaale iyo {{GENDER:cinwaanka iimaylkaaga}} ayaa si gaar ah loola wadaagi doonaa [[meta:Special:MyLanguage/Threats_of_harm|kooxda xaaladaha degdegga ah ee Wikimedia Foundation]].
reportincident-physical-harm-footer: {{GENDER:|Warbixintaada}} waa [[Foundation:Special:MyLanguage/Policy:Privacy_policy#How_We_Use_Information_We_Receive_From_You|mid gaar ah]] waxaana loo diri doonaa [[meta:Special:MyLanguage/Threats_of_harm|kooxda xaaladaha degdegga ah ee Wikimedia Foundation]] si dib loogu eego.
reportincident-behavior-required: Fadlan dooro nooca dhaqanka aan la aqbali karin
reportincident-threat-harm-required: Ikhtiyaarka "Hanjabaad waxyeello" waa in la bixiyaa
reportincident-submit-emergency-dialog-t: {{GENDER:|Mahadsanid}} inaad qaaday tallaabooyin lagu hagaajinayo amniga iyo ka mid noqoshada {{SITENAME}}.
reportincident-submit-emergency-success: Warbixinta ayaa loo gudbiyay dib u eegis. {{GENDER:|Codsigaaga}} waxaa la eegi doonaa 3 saacadood gudahood.
reportincident-submit-emergency-section-: Haddii {{GENDER:|aad}} dhaawacantay ama {{GENDER:aad ku jirto}} khatar degdeg ah, wac adeegyada xaaladaha degdegga ah ee deegaankaaga

Haddii {{GENDER:|aad}} dareento in {{GENDER:|aad}} si jireed u waxyeellayn karto {{GENDER:|naftaada}} ama dadka kale, {{GENDER:|waxaad}} ka heli kartaa [[meta:Special:MyLanguage/Mental_health_resources|liiska ilaha taageerada]].

{{GENDER:|Warbixintaada}} waxaa loo gudbiyay [[meta:Special:MyLanguage/Threats_of_harm|kooxda xaaladaha degdegga ah ee Wikimedia Foundation]]. Kooxdu waxay la socotaa warbixinnada xaaladaha degdegga ah 24/7, waxaana {{GENDER:|codsigaaga}} la eegi doonaa 3 saacadood gudahood.
Waan dib u eegi doonnaa waxaana go'aamin doonnaa in dhacdadani ay jebinayso siyaasadaha.
Haddii {{GENDER:|aad}} u baahan tahay inaad gudbiso faahfaahin dheeraad ah, fadlan iimayl u dir [mailto:emergency@wikimedia.org emergency@wikimedia.org].
reportincident-submit-behavior-notice: Maamulayaashu waxay kaa caawin karaan [[$1|dhacdooyinka degdegga ah iyo dhibaatooyinka sii socda ee la xiriira dhaqanka isticmaalayaasha]].
reportincident-submit-behavior-section-s: [[Foundation:Special:MyLanguage/Policy:Universal_Code_of_Conduct#3_–_Unacceptable_behaviour|Dhaqanka aan la aqbali karin]] waxaa maamula bulshada isticmaalayaasha khibradda leh ee {{SITENAME}}:

[[Foundation:Special:MyLanguage/Policy:Universal_Code_of_Conduct|Xeerka Anshaxa Caalamiga ah]] wuxuu leeyahay [[Foundation:Special:MyLanguage/Policy:Universal_Code_of_Conduct/Enforcement_guidelines|tilmaamaha fulinta]] oo sharaxaya sida dhaqanka aan habboonayn loo xallinayo.

[[$1|Xallinta khilaafaadka]] badanaa waa tallaabada ugu horreysa ee arrimaha fudud ee wiki-ga. Haddii {{GENDER:|aad}} dareento ammaan inaad sidaas samayso, {{GENDER:|waxaad}} isku dayi kartaa inaad la hadasho qofka {{GENDER:|aad}} ka warbixinayso, adigoo adeegsanaya boggiisa wada hadalka isticmaaleha.
Maamulayaashu waxay kaa caawin karaan [[$1|dhacdooyinka degdegga ah iyo kuwa sii socda]].
Haddii {{GENDER:|aad}} cusub tahay, [[Special:Homepage|weydii {{GENDER:|hagahaaga}} inuu ku hago habka]].
Dhammaan wada sheekaysiyada ku jira wikiyadu waa dadweyne, fadlan ha wadaagin macluumaad shakhsi ah.
reportincident-submit-behavior-section-o: Ma heli kari weyday waxa {{GENDER:|aad}} raadineyso?
Haddii {{GENDER:|aadan}} hubin waxa la sameeyo, [[$1|fadlan bulshada weydii caawimo]].

Haddii tallaabooyinka kor ku xusan aysan {{GENDER:|ku}} caawin, {{GENDER:|waxaad}} la xiriiri kartaa [[meta:Special:MyLanguage/Wikimedia_Foundation/Contact_us|hay'adda aan faa'iido doonka ahayn]] ee martigelisa degelkan.
communityconfiguration-reportincident-de: Habee xiriiriyeyaasha maxalliga ah ee ay isticmaasho socodka aan degdegga ahayn ee Nidaamka Warbixinta Dhacdooyinka, oo maamul meel magaca uu nidaamku ka shaqaynayo.
communityconfiguration-reportincident-in: Nidaamka Warbixinta Dhacdooyinka wuxuu u tilmaamaa isticmaalayaasha gudbiya warbixinnada iyada oo loo marayo socodka aan degdegga ahayn bogagga wiki-ga maxalliga ah ee ku habboon. Kuwaas halkan ayaa lagu habayn karaa. Haddii meel bannaan laga tago, wuxuu isticmaali doonaa qiimayaasha caadiga ah ee ku jira qaabeynta la hirgeliyay.
communityconfiguration-reportincident-re: Bog wiki ah oo isticmaalayaashu ay bulshada ku weydiin karaan su'aalo.
Bogga maxalliga ah ee warbixinta dhacdada
Bog wiki ah oo isticmaalayaashu ay dhacdooyinka ugu soo sheegi karaan maamulayaasha maxalliga ah.
Bog wiki ah oo isticmaalayaashu ay ka heli karaan macluumaad ku saabsan xallinta khilaafaadka ka jira wiki-ga.
Meel magacyada uu Nidaamka Warbixinta Dhacdooyinka ka shaqaynayo.
